description: Contacts Management and CRM view. Allows users to view, filter, segment, and manage their lead/customer database.

layout_structure.topbar: Page Title: 'Contacts', Action: 'Import Contacts' (Secondary), 'Add Contact' (Primary, Kournikova).
layout_structure.main_area: Full width data table with advanced filtering above it.

toolbar.layout: Flex horizontal, space-between, padding 16px, background surface.primary, border-bottom.
left_actions: Search Input (Find by name, phone, email)

data_table.style: Clean white table, subtle borders between rows, no vertical borders. Header row light gray (#F9FAFB).
data_table.row_interactions: Hover row highlights light gray. Clicking a row opens the 'Smart Context Card' in a right-side sliding drawer (Overlay).

visual_prompt_notes: A clean, modern SaaS data table interface for a CRM. The screen shows a list of contacts with columns for Name (with small circular avatars), Phone, Email, Status (green/red pills), and Tags (lavender and blue pills). Above the table is a search bar and filter buttons. The background is white. Top right has a bright yellow 'Add Contact' button. The style should be minimal, professional, and well-spaced.
